claims.short_name: Exhaustive necessary Lovasz cut profiles and unique five-vertex internal block
claims.claim_text: For D=3, alpha=1, beta=2 and at most ten degree-three vertices, all 72 relevant component-size partitions satisfying the numerical necessary cut bounds have unique candidate profile (5,5) with one unit of weighted boundary per component. Every 7-edge simple graph on 5 vertices of degree profile (2,3,3,3,3) is isomorphic to K5 minus a length-two path and a disjoint edge.
claims.support_summary: Exact standalone Python integer partition enumeration over 72 necessary cut profiles; independent exhaustive 1,024 labelled five-vertex graph enumeration finds 30 valid labelled graphs, all of one isomorphism type.

claims.short_name: 16–18 edge subcubic cap obstructions contain the unique sixteen-edge motif
claims.claim_text: Every finite simple graph of maximum degree at most three and 16, 17 or 18 edges failing a (1,2) degree-capped two-colouring contains the unique sixteen-edge two-block obstruction as a subgraph, with any remaining edges avoiding the ten saturated block vertices. With exactly 16 edges, the obstruction is unique up to isomorphism and isolates.
claims.support_summary: Complete paper deduction from ordinary Lovasz tight-component criterion and earlier subcubic at-least-10-saturated theorem, with parity-forced cut weights, 34 tight-component size profiles checked separately for each E=16,17,18, cut-budget uniqueness, and exact 16-edge motif subgraph. No full Lean checker of the Lovasz theorem.

claims.short_name: Fourteen ordered 3-star exclusions through 18-edge motif recolouring
claims.claim_text: Conditionally on the admitted paper-level 3x3 joint-residual reduction, the unique 16-edge obstruction can be red/blue coloured so each colour has at most six nonisolated vertices, avoiding every three-positive-star target with largest star ≥2; hence fourteen ordered parameter pairs are excluded (four at E=16 and ten further at E=17 or 18), reducing the prior 39 method survivors to 25 (13 unordered), all in forced degree 4.
claims.support_summary: Independent exact canonical motif construction and six-vertex-support red/blue colouring; complete enumeration of 216 exterior-edge graph/target assignments at E=17,18; fourteen-case output compared against the SHA-256 pinned 39-case upstream ledger. Original three-star upper/lower formula conditional on the upstream unpromoted paper-level joint-residual theorem.
